Service: test-03-hybrid-gce-worker (Cloud Run primary dispatcher). Env vars: BATCH_WORKER_INSTANCE_TEMPLATE, BATCH_WORKER_NAME_PREFIX, BATCH_WORKER_ZONE, COMPLETION_TOPIC, INPUTS_BUCKET, OUTPUTS_BUCKET. Ephemeral VM insertion via compute API: instances.insert(zone=BATCH_WORKER_ZONE, sourceInstanceTemplate=BATCH_WORKER_INSTANCE_TEMPLATE, name=f'{BATCH_WORKER_NAME_PREFIX}-{job_id}'), polling instances.get on the chosen name.
Service: batch-worker (GCE VM worker). Debian 12 minimal, no external IP. Startup script reads instance metadata: INPUTS_BUCKET, OUTPUTS_BUCKET from computeMetadata/v1/instance/attributes/<KEY>. Completes transform, writes output summary to gs://OUTPUTS_BUCKET/{job_id}_summary.json, publishes completion event, and runs sudo poweroff.
IaC Custom Resources (infra/workload/custom.tf): google_storage_bucket.batch_inputs, google_storage_bucket.batch_outputs, google_pubsub_topic.job_completed_topic. Platform renders compute modules.
